name: Gi21 Capital
decision_note: Prague multi-stage investment group of Damir Špoljarič deploying principal capital across AI data centres, hospitality and tech startups; an active startup investor (Boost.space 2025, FaceUp and Hermetiq 2026) but a private investment holding rather than a VC fund.

evidence.quote: Gi21 Capital is a multi-stage investment group bridging the gap between entrepreneurial agility and institutional-grade scale.
Backing technical founders solving complex problems through Deep Tech, B2B SaaS, AI.
Gi21 Capital has invested in Hermetiq's $2.2M seed round.
Why We Invested in FaceUp: Bringing Safety and Integrity to Global Workplaces
Hlavním investorem je skupina Jet Investment miliardáře Igora Faita s přispěním českého fond Tachles VC, Gi21 Capital Damira Špoljariče a stávajících akcionářů.

We deploy principal capital to accelerate global AI-first startups and leverage institutional fund structures to build the continent's most ambitious digital assets—including the largest pan-European AI data center platform.

analyst_notes: Quick exclusion dossier. Discovered as co-investor in the Boost.space round (CzechCrunch 2025-10-09). Classified private_investor (S1): the group invests the principals' own capital ('principal capital') alongside AI data-centre funds, hospitality and art patronage; startup investing is one business line, not a pooled VC fund. Startup activity is current (Hermetiq seed 2026-08-27, FaceUp 2026-05-21 per own blog; Boost.space 2025-10-09), so it may deserve a vc record if the pilot later counts dedicated balance-sheet venture arms. FaceUp country not stated on the cited page. Geography, ticket and capital not disclosed.
